description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractCommandStrategy which provides a base implementation for command handling strategies within a persistent actors framework, using generics for command, entity, context, and result types. It includes mechanisms for applying commands, calculating metadata, and error handling for unhandled commands.

classes.name: AbstractCommandStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for command strategies that handle commands within a persistent actor framework. It manages command applicability, metadata calculation, and error handling for unhandled commands, utilizing generics for flexibility.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a command to a given context and entity, performing checks and logging, and delegating to doApply if applicable.

methods.name: calculateRelativeMetadata
methods.description: Abstract method to compute optional metadata based on the entity and command.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Abstract method to execute command logic after applicability is confirmed.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Throws an IllegalArgumentException indicating the command is not handled by this strategy.

methods.name: getMatchingClass
methods.description: Returns the command class type that this strategy handles.
